decisions.statement: Every file a walk over everything names is judged.
A path the audit listed and no longer in the tree refuses the run.
No length is answered for a file the check could not measure.
A file's length is the length of the body its path opens.
A link is measured by what that link opens rather than by the link.
Every phase answers one length for one path.
A path opening no body has no length to judge.
A path that will not open refuses the run.
An entry file is held to the widest byte ceiling of any file.
An entry file has the `jsonl` or the `json` extension.
A markup file is held to a byte ceiling wider than a code file's ceiling.
A markup file has the `xml` extension.
The game rather than akasha decides where a markup file may be divided.
A prose file is held to a byte ceiling wider than a code file's ceiling.
A prose file has the `md` or the `txt` extension.
The author rather than akasha decides where prose may be divided.
A refusal for a prose file names the cost dividing prose puts on a reader.
A refusal for a markup file names the division an addon's manifest admits.
A refusal for a test file names the `test-fixtures` file standing beside that test file.
A property saying its files are not judged for length lets those files off.
A property naming its file is read from the file's own name.
That file is let off only where a page with the property sits in its folder.
A file of that name in another folder is held to the ceiling.
A property naming no file is read from the section its files have.
A file that section names is let off only under a page type carrying that property.
Two properties sharing a section name are told apart by the page type in the name.
A folder property saying its files are not judged for length lets them off too.
That folder is read from the name the property states.
A file beneath that folder is let off only where a page with the property sits above it.
A file under a folder of that name elsewhere is held to the ceiling.
An extension property saying its files are not judged for length lets them off.
That extension is read from the name the property states.
A file closing that way is let off only where a page with the property sits in its folder.
A file closing that way in a folder beneath that page is held to the ceiling.
Which files a machine writes is a question asked elsewhere.

definition: the check refusing a file whose body is over the byte ceiling its kind is held to
